title: Kid Icarus Music Disc Pack
description: Nintendo Music Disc Series: VOLUME VII
body:
This Data and Resource Pack collection adds 24 craftable music discs from the NES and Famicom Disk System releases of Kid Icarus.

### TRACKLIST
All track names are sourced from the Nintendo Music app. Song titles are the same between both versions
- Title Theme
- Stage 1
- Boss BGM
- Stage Clear
- Stage 2
- Fortress
- Stage 3
- Reaper's Theme
- Game Over
- Stage 4
- Final Boss BGM
- Ending Theme

DISCLAIMER: Due to this game not having an official soundtrack release outside of Nintendo Music, song length and audio quality may not 100% reflect how it appears on the app.

### CRAFTING GUIDE
A smithing table is required to obtain discs added in these packs. The recipes are displayed in the Advancements tab, which unlocks when you obtain any Music Disc and either a Copper Bulb for the Famicom version or White Wool for the NES version. The Advancement tab shows a checklist of each song with the required *"addition"* item needed to obtain it as the Advancement icon.
